Reliable optical inspection requires clear boundaries and stable feature positions. R152 reconstructs microscopy images on the original pixel grid and connects them to one geometric measurement pipeline.
One fixed set of learned weights processes 20× and 50× images with objective-specific optical information. Bounded correction sharpens pillar boundaries on the native grid [1, 2].
Representative pillar fields at 20× and 50×. R152 yields clearer boundaries on the native pixel grid. Scale bars: 2 µm.
R152 combines PSF-guided reconstruction, anti-aliased processing and bounded output correction. The optical inputs comprise 25 kernels at 20× and one calibrated kernel at 50×.
All image methods share one LSC pipeline [3, 4]. Each pillar uses 720 radial samples and three center-refinement passes. The median horizontal shift of nine pillars defines each step.
Step SD: mean of four condition-level standard deviations.
Nominal MAE: mean absolute difference from the set step.
Within-grid SD: median of 120 nine-pillar standard deviations.
Lower median within-grid SD versus Raw
R152 achieves the lowest measured values for all three criteria across the four imaging conditions.
R152 reduces median within-grid variation from 10.86 nm to 4.26 nm, a 60.8% reduction relative to Raw.
Step SD and nominal MAE decrease by 19.5% and 23.1%, respectively. The same learned weights deliver the lowest measured values in every tested condition.
Step variation reaches 0.056 pixel at 20× and 0.067 pixel at 50×. R152 combines clear pillar boundaries with stronger positional consistency across both objectives.
[1] O. Ronneberger et al., U-Net, MICCAI, 2015, pp. 234–241.
[2] R. Zhang, Making convolutional networks shift-invariant again, ICML, 2019, pp. 7324–7334.
[3] T. F. Chan and L. A. Vese, Active contours without edges, IEEE Trans. Image Process., 10(2), 266–277, 2001.
[4] N. Chernov and C. Lesort, Least squares fitting of circles, J. Math. Imaging Vis., 23, 239–252, 2005.

Images: inspection/images/2_0000_Raw.png, 2_0000_R152.png, 0_0000_Raw.png, 0_0000_R152.png. These are the first locked 0.5 µm frames at each objective with common 0–1 display mapping.
Current poster readout: radial 720-direction geometric LSC with three refinement passes. The model and raw data are fixed.
50x optics: original calibrated single PSF, installed through the optional input adapter. 20x optics: native R152 25-kernel bank.
Percent reductions use unrounded aggregate values. All four condition-level values support the stated lowest-value comparison among Raw, Wiener and R152.
Bibliography metadata follows references [3], [4], [6], [8] of the supplied manuscript.
